title: Weighed from the concept end · a new drawing in the measured grammar

reference.grammar: A scale, an envelope and a stamp in flat color.

techniques.name: Measured grammar

fills.label: Fills
fills.note: 1 lays the flat fills; 0 takes them out.

stacks.label: Stacks
stacks.note: 1 draws the stacked forms; 0 takes them out.

marks.label: Marks
marks.note: 1 lays the marks; 0 takes them out.

key.label: Key
key.note: 1 draws the keyline; 0 takes it out.

texture.label: Texture
texture.note: 1 lays the texture pass; 0 leaves the drawing flat.

nogram.label: Without the grammar
nogram.note: 1 draws the same subject without the measured grammar, for comparison.

techniques.implementation: A scale, an envelope and a stamp drawn in flat color from measured proportions. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
